name: netEstate NE Crawler
description: The crawler netEstate GmbH runs for its information-extraction products. The operator documents two uses: an Impressums-Crawler that locates a site's imprint page and extracts postal addresses, contact data and company names for address verification, and a Jobcrawler that finds job postings on employer websites. netEstate states that the crawler observes robots.txt, the robots meta element and common opt-out wordings, and that it returns only a hash of any email address rather than the address itself.
